건강기록은 지금까지 기관마다 따로 쌓였습니다. SportiQue는 그 중: Health records have piled up separately at each institution. SportiQue moves the centre to the individual who owns the record.
지금까지와 SportiQue가 만드는 것: Until now, and what SportiQue is building
Records stay separately at each hospital and service.
The individual gathers and manages them in one place.
When a study ends, the link with its participants ends too.
The records stay with the individual after the study ends.
Moving to another hospital or country breaks the record.
The goal is a record that carries on after a move.
Review accumulated records as a non-diagnostic summary for each period.
Ask health questions in a chat. It does not replace a diagnosis.
Once records are gathered, more ways to use them open up.
다른 개발사의 서비스가 같은 동의 구조 위에서 열리는 길을 만들고 있습니: A path for other developers' services to open on the same consent structure is being built.
DataQ는 원본과 출처를 보존하면서 기록의 형식·항목·단위를 맞추는 단: DataQ is the step that aligns the format, items and units of records while preserving the originals and their sources. MediQ and MindQ are planned as in-app experiences that will open inside UniQdata later.
연구팀과 기관을 위한 운영 도구로 개발하고 있습니다. 개인의 기록은 동의: It is being developed as an operations tool for research teams and institutions. Personal records are not automatically shared beyond the consented purpose and scope.
Bodab은 어르신이 직접 쓰는 앱으로, 지금은 준비 중이라 스토어에서: Bodab is an app for older adults to use themselves. It is in preparation and cannot be downloaded from the stores yet.
동의와 이용 이력의 증빙은 한 시간 단위로 묶어, 그 요약값만 XRPL: Evidence of consent and use history is grouped into hourly batches, and only a digest of each batch is recorded on the XRPL mainnet. Original health records and per-person records are not uploaded.
